run_retrieval_evaluation: run single-hop retrieval evaluation on a QA dataset using a trained BERT retriever model and FAISS index
run_gpu_retrieval: run retrieval evaluation with GPU acceleration by passing the --gpu flag to use FAISS GPU resources
run_unified_model_eval: run evaluation with a unified retriever model trained on both HotpotQA and Natural Questions datasets
save_retrieval_predictions: save top-K retrieved document predictions and coverage metrics to a JSON lines file for later analysis
evaluate_recall_at_k: evaluate top-K recall metrics across multiple K values (5, 10, 20, 50, 100) for a set of QA pairs
